items.headline: Arizona grabs onside kick, hits late FG to pull out TCU win
items.description: Arizona recovered an onside kick to set up a 37-yard field goal with under a minute to go as the Wildcats stunned TCU 29-28.

items.headline: Salgado-Medina makes field goal after recovered onside pooch kick, No. 24 Arizona stuns TCU 29-28
items.description: — Michael Salgado-Medina kicked a 37-yard field goal with 39 seconds left after No. 24 Arizona recovered an onside pooch kick and the Wildcats pulled out an improbable 29-28 victory over TCU early Saturday.
